description: Check a website's SEO basics and its AEO (AI search readiness). SEO: HTTPS, http to https redirect, noindex, viewport, title and description lengths, one h1, canonical, language, image alt text, and response time and HTML size measured from pigfox.ai's server, as seo_score out of 100 with each check's pass, warn or fail. AEO: per-crawler robots.txt access for OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot, DuckAssistBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot and Bytespider, llms.txt, the homepage's title and description lengths, canonical, language, h1 and JSON-LD types, a one-line definition, key facts in text rather than images, a recent date, as score out of 100 with its band and fixes with the points each is worth; combined_score averages the two; and copy-paste snippets built from the site's own data with [REPLACE: ...] where it says nothing. Fetches only the homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt, a HEAD of llms-full.txt, one sitemap and the headers of http://<site>/.

site.description: The site's domain, such as example.com. A full URL is accepted; only its host is used.

name: check_ai_search_readiness
title: Check SEO and AEO (AI search readiness)
